enacted.method: Enacted districts assign each 2020 block by its internal point; Polsby-Popper uses shapes clipped to the 1:500,000 cartographic land outline and simplified to about 500 m, measured in a plane local to each district.

limitations: Source adjacency and the full source-to-district dissolve were not regenerated; their saved audits were checked.
County payload hashes were verified; every county feature was not reparsed to reconstruct assignments.
Recorded endpoint source GEOID, local polygon part, boundary coordinate and district ownership were checked; historical global part-node numbering was not regenerated.
Some legacy payloads lack a historical raw SHA; retained raw/gzip bytes were compared exactly.
